description: Defines the XPUGuardImpl class implementing device guard functionalities for XPU devices, including device management, stream handling, and event synchronization.

classes.name: XPUGuardImpl
classes.description: Implementation of device guard interface for XPU devices, managing device context, streams, and events.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the device type, which is XPU.

methods.name: exchangeDevice
methods.description: Switches the current device to the specified device and returns the previous device.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the current device.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Sets the current device.

methods.name: uncheckedSetDevice
methods.description: Sets the current device without checks.

methods.name: getDeviceCapability
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the specified device.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Gets the current stream for the device.

methods.name: getNewStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new stream with specified priority.

methods.name: getStreamFromGlobalPool
methods.description: Gets a stream from the global pool, with optional high priority.

methods.name: exchangeStream
methods.description: Replaces the current stream with a new one and returns the old stream.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the number of XPU devices.

methods.name: destroyEvent
methods.description: Deletes a GPU event.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records an event on a stream.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Blocks until an event is complete.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Checks if an event has completed.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two events.

methods.name: queryStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream is active.

methods.name: synchronizeStream
methods.description: Synchronizes a stream.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes an event.

methods.name: synchronizeDevice
methods.description: Synchronizes all streams on a device.

methods.name: recordDataPtrOnStream
methods.description: Records a data pointer on a stream.
